rationale: Every AREA 3, cap213, timing-driven run with post-GRT timing repair lands at 12.59-12.85 ns, and constraints are far from binding (hold +0.08 ns, <=10 slew/cap pins, 0 DRC); DELAY scripts, stock RC and low-utilisation runs did worse. ocs_blitter reached 12.85 from an 11.1 ns target (slack only -1.7 ns) without ABC buffering/sizing or post-GRT design repair, while the 9 ns runs ended near -3.6 ns. Setting 1 reruns ocs_blitter changing only the target to 9 ns: it separates target effect from recipe effect and could beat 12.585. Setting 2 keeps the best run's recipe and target but compacts placement (util 46, density 62) for shorter wires and repairs slew/cap harder (35/25%) to cut wire delay.
